name: stm32cubemx-control
description: Drive STM32CubeMX from the command line or from an AI agent: create a project from an MCU name, reconfigure an existing one, place pins, regenerate code headlessly and verify with a Keil MDK build.

interface.shortDescription: Create and reconfigure CubeMX projects without the GUI
interface.longDescription: Inspect what an MCU can be configured with from CubeMX's own device database, create a project from nothing but a part number, reconfigure an existing one, let CubeMX validate and normalise every edit, place pins it could not assign, regenerate code headlessly, and verify the result with a Keil MDK build. Reports a per-key diff of what CubeMX accepted or dropped, backs up before generating, and detects hung sessions.
defaultPrompt: Create a new CubeMX project for STM32G431CBUx
Enable TIM1 complementary PWM and regenerate
Why did CubeMX drop the peripheral I configured?
